changelog:
Initial release of agent-orchestrator: a meta-agent skill for orchestrating complex tasks via autonomous sub-agents.

- Decomposes macro tasks into parallelizable subtasks using clear principles and a dependency graph.
- Spawns specialized sub-agents with dynamically generated SKILL.md files and isolated workspaces.
- Coordinates file-based communication among agents using clear inbox/outbox/status.json protocols.
- Periodically monitors agent progress with checkpoint-based status updates.
- Consolidates and validates outputs from all agents, merges results, and dissolves agent workspaces upon completion.
- Provides pre-built sub-agent templates and best practices for effective multi-agent orchestration.
summary:
Meta-agent skill for orchestrating complex tasks through autonomous sub-agents. Decomposes macro tasks into subtasks, spawns specialized sub-agents with dynamically generated SKILL.md files, coordinates file-based communication, consolidates results, and dissolves agents upon completion.

MANDATORY TRIGGERS: orchestrate, multi-agent, decompose task, spawn agents, sub-agents, parallel agents, agent coordination, task breakdown, meta-agent, agent factory, delegate tasks
